comments.author: @FlapJack-z2s
comments.text:
In 2023 myself and my wife lived off of 4-6k total a month in CA. It wasn't easy, but we made it work. I was working 2 jobs and my wife was working 1 job. Modern Americans don't know how to budget. I am not saying the economy is great, but it isn't all the economy's fault.

We were living in a studio apartment that was the size of a 1 car garage. We had no dishwasher and no in unit laundry. We only ate out once a month and sometimes we didn't even do that. We cooked all our meals, frozen meals were a treat. We limited our travel to local areas only because gas in CA is so expensive. Our dates consisted of playing tennis with second hand balls and rackets while we waited for our laundry in the laundry mat across the street. We wore the same clothes we had owned since highschool, save a cheap suit I bought for interviews. This was far from an ideal situation, but we found pleasure in the little things like our love for each other and our dreams for the future. Because of our strict budget and work ethic we were able to slowly set aside enough to have a small savings and the ability to leave CA for a better state.

It's not easy, but it is possible.
